visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two women sit at a dining table in a brightly lit indoor restaurant. The woman on the left, with long dark hair and a white long-sleeved shirt, rests her chin on her hand, smiling. The woman on the right, with brown hair in a bun and a yellow sleeveless top, speaks while gesturing with her hands. A plate of french fries with ketchup and a white sauce sits in the foreground on a marble table. (2) The camera remains static as the woman on the right becomes more animated, raising her finger and widening her eyes while speaking. The woman on the left continues to smile and nod. The background shows soft indoor lighting and other tables. (3) The woman on the right continues her story, her facial expressions shifting between serious mimicry and amusement. The woman on the left begins to chuckle, eventually covering her mouth with her hand. (4) Both women break into hearty laughter. The woman on the left leans back, her eyes crinkling. The woman on the right claps her hands together briefly while continuing to talk through her laughter. The environment remains a clean, modern restaurant setting.
